macros.name: bspcurvenodes
macros.doc: The macro \bspcurvenodes{P}{R} creates a node sequence R0..Rn at the locations specified by the arrays P.X, P.Y.

macros.name: bspcurvepointsE
macros.doc: \bspcurvepointsE{B}{5}{P}: does the same as \bspcurvepoints, but omits the first and last segments.

macros.name: psBsplineE
macros.doc: There is a closely related macro \psBsplineE which removes the first and last Bézier segments, much as \psecurve acts in relation to \pscurve, allowing one to draw B-splines with non-zero curvature at the endpoints.

macros.name: psBsplineE
macros.doc: There is a closely related macro \psBsplineE which removes the first and last Bézier segments, much as \psecurve acts in relation to \pscurve, allowing one to draw B-splines with non-zero curvature at the endpoints.

macros.name: psBsplineInterp
macros.doc: \psBsplineInterp{S}{4}: will construct a sequence SB0..SB4 for which the associated B-spline curve interpolates S0..S4.

macros.name: psBsplineInterpC
macros.doc: \psBsplineInterpC{S}{4}: will construct a sequence SB0..SB5 for which the associated closed B-spline curve interpolates S0..S4.

macros.name: psBsplineNodes
macros.doc: \psBsplineNodes{B}{4}: draws the relaxed, uniform B-spline with control points B0..B4.

macros.name: psBsplineNodes
macros.doc: \psBsplineNodes{B}{4}: draws the relaxed, uniform B-spline with control points B0..B4.

macros.name: thickBEspline
macros.doc: \thickBEspline{S}{5}{30pt}{18pt}{-70}{<graphic>}: defines a clipping path of width from 18pt to 30pt and axis angle -70 degrees, then draws the <graphic> clipped to that path.

macros.name: thickBEspline
macros.doc: \thickBEspline{S}{5}{30pt}{18pt}{-70}{<graphic>}: defines a clipping path of width from 18pt to 30pt and axis angle -70 degrees, then draws the <graphic> clipped to that path.

macros.name: thickBspline
macros.doc: \thickBspline{B}{5}{12pt}{<graphic to clip>}: defines a clipping path 12pt wide around the B-spline curve with control points B0..B5, then draws the <graphic> clipped to that path.

macros.name: thickBspline
macros.doc: \thickBspline{B}{5}{12pt}{<graphic to clip>}: defines a clipping path 12pt wide around the B-spline curve with control points B0..B5, then draws the <graphic> clipped to that path.
